verdict.rationale: BigQuery's own docs show predefined IAM roles and granular permissions that apply to datasets, tables, views, and routines, so the table-level, role-based part of the story is documented. The pack has nothing on column-level security, row-level access policies, or data masking, which are the bulk of the story. missing for 10: column-level access control, row-level access policies, dynamic data masking policies, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-team governance

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, access control reaches tables, columns, and rows — roles plus masking policies — so one warehouse can serve many teams safely

citations.quote: Roles and permissions that apply to BigQuery resources such as datasets, tables, views, and routines.
Identity and Access Management (IAM) lets you control access to BigQuery resources by using predefined roles and granular permissions.
